title: The Phantom Warning
details: I was drifting through town, lost in thought, when I stepped into the street without looking. A piercing shriek sliced through the air—an old woman, her voice cracking like dead leaves underfoot. She pointed a trembling finger at me and whispered something I couldn't quite catch before vanishing into the mist.

title: The Pianist's Lament
details: We wandered into the skeleton of an abandoned theater, its air thick with forgotten breath. As we crept through its crumbling halls, a piano melody began to drift—low, haunting, almost human. The keys moved on their own, playing a piece that felt older than the building itself.

title: The Haunting in Pontefract
details:
The disturbances at this residential property began in 1966 when the Pritchard family moved in and experienced extreme poltergeist activity.
• Black Monk of Pontefract: Witnesses described seeing a tall, shadowy, hooded figure resembling a medieval monk moving silently through the rooms.
• Physical Disturbances: Family members reported furniture sliding across floors, green-tinted foam spitting from taps, and heavy objects being thrown across rooms by an invisible force.
• Unexplained Sensations: Visitors and inhabitants frequently noted sudden drops in temperature and a persistent, unidentifiable burning smell lingering on the upper floor.
